title: Modern PHP 8: enums, readonly, match, attributes, fibers

preview.what: The modern PHP features that separate 2026 code from 2018 code.
preview.picture: Enums are a fixed menu (Status::Paid, not the string 'paid'); readonly is a sealed envelope; match is a smarter switch; attributes are sticky notes on code that frameworks read.
preview.why: Recruiters check whether your PHP stopped in the Laravel 5 era.
preview.bn: Enum (নির্দিষ্ট মেনু), readonly (সিল করা খাম), match, attribute — আধুনিক PHP-এর ভাষা।
